title: Multiple tries; couldn’t get this to work ...
text:
Multiple tries; couldn’t get this to work .... I never could get this to produce a cooked hotdog and steamed bun that were satisfactory. I’ve gone through 2 packages of hotdogs and 2.5 packages of buns, trying various cooking times, and either the bun is OK and hot dog barely warmed, or the hot dog is cooked nicely but the bun is tough or dried out. I’m using your basic supermarket brand-name hotdogs and buns, so I don’t think that’s the problem. Could be the microwave (GE built-in, about 10 yrs old).

Then there’s the issue of sliding the “drawer” out after you flip the unit over after cooking. Most of the time, the edge of the drawer caught on the hotdog, causing it to break. Never could get the hotdog to “drop” into the bun.

Honestly, I get a better result just nuking the hot dog(s) on a covered plate, then zapping the bun for a few seconds. The entire process takes less time. This was a good idea, but didn’t work for me

product_metadata.title: Hot Doglicious Microwave Hot Dog Cooker
features: The Hot Doglicious perfectly cooks the hot dog and steams the bun in under a minute (Cooking times will vary based upon the wattage of your microwave)
Works with beef, chicken and veggie franks
Made from BPA-Free, food safe material that accelerates and enhances cooking
Simply put the hot dog in the cooking chamber, place the bun on top of it, put the lid on and then microwave
Dishwasher safe for quick and easy clean up; top rack only
description: The Hot Doglicious is designed to make a vendor-style hot dog in the microwave.  Easily make a perfectly cooked hot dog in under a minute with the Hot Doglicious. Simply put the hot dog in the cooking chamber, place the bun on top of it, put the lid on and then microwave! The cooking chamber features ribs that pierce the hot dog’s casing, allowing it to grill and sear from the inside out, while the vent lets steam escape to warm the bun. The Hot Doglicious works with beef, chicken and veggie franks. Made from BPA-free, food safe materials that accelerates and enhances cooking. Additional cooking options: To slightly steam the bun, cook the hot dog without the bun for half the time, then add the bun for the remaining cook time. Or you can cook the hot dog without adding a bun. Dishwasher safe – top rack only. Not for oven use. *Cooking times will vary based upon the wattage of your microwave. Adjust cooking time based on the results. Patent Pending.
